name: Elmsford Extravaganza III 2026
information:
Please note that this competition takes place on a **Tuesday evening**. Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest in order to maintain safety and manage the pace of the competition. We strongly encourage competitors to avoid bringing a guest if possible.

All competitors **MUST** arrive by 6:30pm and stay until the end of the competition, regardless of which group they are assigned to compete in. Any competitor who does not arrive at this time or attempts to leave early will be subject to disqualification, including at future competitions.
